Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost breakdowns were super helpful. We're evaluating an upgrade from our current Growth Pro plan (approx 500k tokens/month, 5 developer seats) to something that supports heavier interactive usage and a smaller on-call ML footprint. Two things we want to understand:

1) A clear migration playbook: how do we move token volume and seats from hosted to a Dedicated pool with minimal downtime?
2) Seat-scaling and feature bundling: we may need 15-20 engineer seats initially with the ability to scale to 40 within 6 months. Which plan + add-ons best match that profile, and what are the price bands / discount ranges for 12-month and 24-month commitments?

I've attached a simple SKU map of our current usage and asks (NovaFin_Migration_SKU_Map.xlsx). Can you sketch a recommended playbook and an estimated price range (ballpark is fine) we can share with procurement?

Appreciate it — copying procurement and Rajiv to keep them in the loop.

Hi Natalie — great to hear from you and thanks for the SKU map. Below is a concise migration playbook and three commercial paths we typically recommend for customers with your growth profile. I kept the numbers high-level; we can tighten them once you share 7-day token distribution and peak RPS.

Migration playbook (minimal downtime approach)
1) Assessment (week 0): verify model sizes, avg/peak seq len, and KV cache needs.
2) Parallel stage (week 1–2): spin up a small Dedicated pool (Dedicated Lite) and route 10–20% of traffic for smoke testing; enable prefix/KV caching to preserve sessions.
3) Ramp (week 3–6): increase traffic to Dedicated pool in 25% increments, monitor latency and token spend; enable automatic fallback to hosted for cold paths.
4) Cutover + cleanup (week 7–8): switch routing to Dedicated as primary, demote hosted to burst/failover; reconcile billing and deprovision excess seats.

Feature mapping & recommended SKUs
- Core Dedicated capacity: Dedicated Lite (predictable throughput) + burst pool for spike protection.
- Seats: Developer seats for console/API access (15 immediate, scale to 40).
- Add-ons we recommend: Priority routing, Extended KV retention (30 days), 24x7 Ops on-call (optional).

Commercial paths (ballpark monthly)
A) Self-serve Dedicated Lite + seats (12mo): ~$12k–$16k/mo before discounts.
B) Committed Dedicated (12mo) with 12%–18% discount + 2-week onboarding credit: ~$10.5k–$14k/mo.
C) Enterprise Reserved (24mo) w/ stronger commit and bundling (priority routing, ops): ~$8.5k–$11k/mo with 18%–25% effective discount and additional credits.

Key asks from your side to firm up a quote
- 7-day token distribution (peak vs median)
- Expected monthly seat ramp schedule
- Any requirement for on-prem or VPC private deployment

I've attached a quick SKU draft I'm happy to iterate on (Draft-MAP-Novafin-SKUs.xlsx). If these ranges look reasonable, I can loop in Markus for a tailored discount and legal next steps.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call to walk through the playbook.

Best,

Hi Natalie / Tessa — looping in a short commercial proposal and approval guardrails from my side.

High-level concession framework (subject to final legal/finance review):
- Target approval: 15% list discount for a 12-month committed Dedicated Lite + seats.
- Escalation band: up to 22% total discount if NovaFin commits to a 24-month term and a token commit >= 1.2M tokens/month.
- One-time onboarding credit: equivalent to 2 weeks of Dedicated capacity (applied as invoice credit).

Bundling notes (to preserve unit economics):
- Priority routing + Extended KV retention bundled as a single "Performance Pack" add-on.
- If NovaFin wants to include 24x7 Ops, that becomes an enterprise add-on (separate SKU) — we can include 1 week of pro bono on-call during initial cutover.

Operational/contract notes:
- We will require a PO or signed SOW referencing deal_id ND-20261102-42.
- Legal will send a starter quote + standard T&Cs; procurement redlines typically take 5–8 business days.

If you confirm the 12 vs 24 month preference and your expected token commit, I will prepare a firm quote and get legal to attach a one-page SOW.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
